What Is Christmas Everyday: Married and Bright About?

Christmas Everyday: Married and Bright reunites Brandy on-screen with her real-life daughter Sy’rai, who plays her sister in the film. The original Lifetime holiday movie is part of the network’s annual “It’s a Wonderful Lifetime” programming event, with new movies every weekend.

According to press materials, Christmas Everyday: Married and Bright follows Chicago fashion designer Fancy Ballantine (Brandy) as she “works to secure the future of her thriving boutique while planning her dream Christmas wedding to her fiancé, Jaylen (Robert C. Riley). With her supportive mother Evelyn (Debbi Morgan), and spirited sister Belle (Sy’rai Smith) by her side, everything seems to be falling into place. But when mounting business pressures and the unexpected return of a reformed ex lead Fancy to shoulder every burden on her own, she unintentionally pushes Jaylen away. As Christmas approaches, Fancy must decide whether she’s willing to let go of the past before it costs her the future she’s always dreamed of.”

The new Brandy movie comes on the heels of a big announcement for the singer, who recently unveiled plans for a co-headlining Las Vegas residency with Monica. The Boy Is Mine Vegas Residency at Resorts World Las Vegas kicks off in May.
